name: audit-a-retained-intron-is-a-spurious-intron
turns: The site shows no RNA-seq junction reads for the last intron of AGAP003685 in A. gambiae PEST. Check its intron support. Is the gene model right?
rationale: A case of the answer key from the recorded unspliced sample: the RNA-seq reads cover the annotated intron unspliced. The audit keeps the error and names the intron in its cause.
